purpose: Companion semantics and usage constraints for a bounded marks and ornaments art packet
status: Candidate contract; inventory and review receipt are supplied by the packet owner

asset_bindings.required_context: Two unequal pen rules pause around a deliberate empty interval. Use between substantial passages, never as a broken data axis.
A long quiet rule ends before a compact cut-nib lozenge. Signals a visual rest without replacing headings or semantic separators.
Two short unequal oblique pen cuts mark a passage in the margin. They do not mean pause, quotation or a mathematical operator.
An open page-corner turn, with a curled return and no enclosing page. A small companion to a note, never a bookmark control.
An asymmetric open saddle supports an adjacent note label. The text or native link carries identity and action; the mark is not a number container.
Two displaced corner cuts reserve an interval between related labels. Matching visible note numbers establish the relationship, not the corners alone.
A small notched tab attaches a page, section or timestamp locator. Pair with Source recorded and the actual locator; no truth or verification claim.
A folded short edge points toward two uneven excerpt rules. Only accompany an actual excerpt with attribution and locator; the rules are not text.
Separated material strokes are bridged by one raised curve. Always pair with the existing Interpretation label; the bridge illustrates reasoning, not a proven implication.
An intentionally open record corner and a detached short entry stroke accompany an explicit missing or unchecked context. The open shape does not establish the reason for the gap.
A short leader stops before a shallow concave landing. It identifies a note's endpoint without an arrowhead. An existing layout owner must supply the measured connector and text relationship.
Two short outward-swept terminals reserve an empty span for a labelled passage or region. They are annotation accents, never a dimension line, error bar or numerical interval.

asset_bindings_note: Each candidate master is bound here; visual observations are in REVIEW.md. Labels are required where specified.

preservation.protected_construction: hooked insight rail with its dot
preservation.shared_tokens: Read existing values; do not modify without coordination with their owner

usage.accent_limit_basis: Packet applies a conservative ceiling of two accent gestures, extending the existing typography rule for handwritten notes; this is not a global-token change

optical_sizes.unit: SVG user units at nominal CSS display size
optical_sizes.status: Authored 16/20/24px optical masters; actual inspection receipt in REVIEW.md

palette.contrast_validation_status: See validation/contrast.json; host compositing remains a consumer check

evidence_note.rule: Keep basis values and visible labels unchanged; companion artwork must not substitute for the label

existing_semantics.source_context_rule: Preserve existing state definitions and exact visible labels; no combined quality score

contextual_accessibility.classification_basis: Actual use in context, not asset filename or shape
contextual_accessibility.companion_to_equivalent_visible_label: Hide the redundant SVG and retain the label
contextual_accessibility.independent_informative_svg: Provide equivalent accessible naming or description; a role=img pattern may reference a unique title ID through aria-labelledby
contextual_accessibility.functional_use: Use a real named link or button; name the action and keep the SVG itself unfocusable
contextual_accessibility.diagram_annotation: Express relationship, direction, scale and uncertainty in text or a legend; decoration establishes no scientific claim

wcag_requirements.requirement: Meaning-bearing graphic parts and relevant control/state information generally require at least 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors
Ordinary small text and images of text require at least 4.5:1 contrast, subject to the criterion's defined exceptions
Do not use color as the sole visual means of conveying information, action or state
Targets generally require 24 by 24 CSS pixels; apply the criterion's explicit spacing, equivalent, inline, user-agent or essential exceptions only when applicable

design_recommendations: Inspect each optical variant at native size at 1x and 2x density
Retain visible labels for unfamiliar semantics
Give thin strokes contrast margin and inspect their rasterization
Keep semantic distinctions understandable in monochrome
Prefer comfortable target areas over reliance on minimum-size exceptions
Do not round a failing contrast ratio upward
validation_claims: None are implied by this document; consult the packet's separate observed review receipt
